verdict.rationale: Running inference on CPU architectures such as PowerPC is a fair question for a local inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions PowerPC, ppc64le, or any CPU architecture beyond Apple silicon and x86/GPU setups. Community notes about CPU fallback or llama.cpp underpinnings do not show that Ollama itself supports other architectures.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
